descriptor: Short illustrated stories told in sideways chapters

voice.summary: Chapterhouse tells stories in quiet, concrete sentences with a lingering end. It sounds like a bedtime reader who trusts a pause more than an exclamation.
dos: Write each chapter in one image and one feeling
Keep sentences short and let white space speak
Number chapters and name the next one

taglines: A short story in five chapters
boilerplate: Chapterhouse publishes short illustrated stories as pinned horizontal-scroll experiences, each told in five chapters that unfold as the reader scrolls.

microcopy.success: The end. Thank you for reading.
microcopy.error: This chapter would not load. Please scroll again.
microcopy.empty: No stories on the shelf yet.

logo.note: A compass suits a story about taking the long way round and keeps the mark simple.
